items.title: Auth forgot password
items.summary: Single-field 'forgot password' page composing the auth-forgot-password block. Dispatches a reset link via adapter.requestPasswordReset and swaps to a 'check your inbox' state on success.

items.title: Auth form (deprecated — see auth-sign-in)
items.summary: [Superseded by auth-sign-in] Login or signup form with validated fields, remember-me, submit button, and error alert. Prefer the auth-sign-in recipe + auth-sign-in-split block for new work — it ships the page-level composition with adapter routing, social providers, and a forgot-password link out of the box.

items.title: Auth reset password
items.summary: 'Set a new password' page paired with a reset link. Composes the auth-reset-password block; the opaque token (typically from a `?token=…` URL parameter) is forwarded verbatim to adapter.resetPassword.

items.title: Auth sign-in (split-screen)
items.summary: Production-grade sign-in page with optional social providers, remember-me, forgot-password link, and pluggable AuthAdapter for credential routing.

items.title: Auth sign-up (centered card)
items.summary: Production-grade sign-up page composing the auth-sign-up-card block. Email + password (with confirm) + optional name + terms checkbox + optional social providers, all routed through a pluggable AuthAdapter.

items.title: Auth verify email (waiting page)
items.summary: Transactional 'check your inbox' page composed from the auth-verify-email block. Mostly visual — optional resend button calls adapter.resendMagicLink with a client-side cooldown timer.

items.title: Auth verify OTP
items.summary: 6-digit (configurable) one-time-code verification page. Composes the auth-verify-otp block which auto-submits when the code is full and routes verification through adapter.verifyOtp({ code, intent }).

items.title: Command palette
items.summary: Cmd-K quick-open palette with grouped actions, search, and keyboard-first navigation.

items.title: Destructive confirm
items.summary: Typed-name confirmation flow for irreversible actions (delete account, drop table).

items.title: Data table view
items.summary: Searchable, paginated data table with row actions menu, status badges, and empty state.

items.title: Pricing table
items.summary: Three-tier pricing grid with a highlighted plan, feature list per tier, CTAs, and tooltips for advanced features.

items.title: Settings page
items.summary: Multi-section settings screen with grouped cards, labeled form fields, toggles, and a save action per section.
